name: westwood_online_upgrade_api_event_sink_on_download_ready_result
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeApiEventSink::OnDownloadReadyResult handles the async WOL download-ready callback by signaling failures, prompting the user, pausing/resuming callback pumping, and handing accepted download-ready lists to the standalone progress dialog.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.

The final success branch displays the post-download message, signals failure, calls OnDestroy, and exits the process; the smoke avoids executing ExitProcess and relies on Binary Ninja control-flow evidence for that noreturn tail.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/HLIL for 0x43f830 validates the stdcall three-argument callback shape, async-error early return, negative-result SetEvent(g_WestwoodOnlineUpgradeFailureEvent), null-list return, ProcessCallbacks pause/resume, localized caption/message copies from message ids 0x3001 and 0x3002, CWnd::MessageBoxA with MB_YESNO|MB_ICONQUESTION and IDYES check, decline path SetEvent plus async-error flag, ShowDownloadReadyList call for accepted lists, show-list-failure resume path, and the accepted-success noreturn tail that displays message id 0x3046, signals failure, calls OnDestroy, and exits.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_api_event_sink_on_download_ready_smoke patches zLoc::GetMessageString, MFC42 CWnd::MessageBoxA, SetEvent, and ShowDownloadReadyList, and verifies async-error no-op, negative-result signaling with null list, decline prompt text/caption/type plus async-error flagging, and accepted-list ShowDownloadReadyList failure with callback-pump restoration.
